title: GPT-6 Astra: Benchmarks, Pricing, and What Solo Builders Should Do
description: GPT-6 Astra launched Sep 3, 2026: computer-use leader, 1.05M context, $10/$50 pricing. Benchmarks, limits, and solo-builder takeaways.
lead: OpenAI released GPT-6 Astra on September 3, 2026 as a computer-use-first model with 1.05M context, leading scores on ARC-AGI-3, FrontierMath, OSWorld and ExploitBench, Standard API pricing of $10 input / $50 output, and first-ever Critical cyber safeguards with gated Daybreak access. This analysis summarizes only official OpenAI sources, with every number linked, plus practical routing and cost guidance for solo builders and local-AI users.
